text:
zoe: Customer AcmeSearch reports 413 on POST /v1/rerank. They sent a single query plus ~500 docs; customer says error message is unhelpful — no token counts. Repro + logs below, can someone triage?

alan: can you paste the raw error and the curl you used to repro?

zoe: sure — exact response: `HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large` and body: `{"error":"input size limit exceeded"}`. Repro curl (sanitized):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"<very long query text...>","documents":[{"id":"d1","text":"<very long doc text...>"}, ..., {"id":"d500","text":"<...>"}]}'
```

zoe: customer says average doc length ~3.5k chars, many long passages. They expect clearer guidance rather than generic 413.

maria: likely token overflow. If average doc -> ~700 tokens and 500 docs => ~350k tokens. Rerank endpoint has practical token ceiling (context + query + docs). We should return the offending token count and the limit in the error to make triage quicker.

eng-ml: agree. Proposed actionable error body: `{"error":"input token limit exceeded","tokens_sent":98432,"token_limit":65536,"hint":"reduce doc count or truncate docs; try prefiltering or chunking"}`. That would let clients programmatically detect and auto-chunk.

prod-ux: +1. UX suggestion for message copy: "Input size exceeded (98,432 tokens). Limit: 65,536. Reduce number of documents, shorten documents, or use our chunking helper: https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank/limits" — include a short code snippet for chunking in our KB.

alan: is this a behaviour change or just error-wire change? Any perf/regressions?

eng-ml: no runtime perf change required. We can change 413 body formatting in API gateway/validation layer and add token counters. For mitigation patterns we can add a server-side soft-fail option: return partial top-N with `warning: truncated_input` so customers get results instead of hard error — but that needs product signoff.

zoe: customer asked for repro steps and a quick mitigation to send now. Suggested support reply: 1) shorten query 2) prefilter documents server-side (e.g., cosine similarity) 3) chunk long documents into <1k-token passages then rerank and aggregate.

eng-ml: quick snippet for support to paste:```
# naive chunker (python)
def chunk_text(text, max_tokens=1000):
    tokens = tokenizer.encode(text)
    for i in range(0, len(tokens), max_tokens):
        yield tokenizer.decode(tokens[i:i+max_tokens])
```
Then call rerank on chunks and merge scores by doc id (e.g., take max or weighted avg).

prod-ux: I'll draft the KB with the new error wording + chunking snippet + recommended thresholds (e.g., prefer <=200 docs, keep total tokens under 60k).

kevin-support-bot: FYI: AcmeSearch (acct id: acct-******) on the Startup plan — we did NOT bill the failed 413 call (system flagged it as error). Logged incident #INC-2505 for visibility.

zoe: assigning follow-ups: @eng-ml to add token-counts to 413 responses, @prod-ux to update KB and sample code, support will send customer the temporary mitigation steps above. Thanks :thumbsup:

alan: one more ask from eng: can we include `tokens_sent` in logs so we can find similar accounts programmatically?

eng-ml: yes, will add tokens_sent to structured logs and to the 413 body. Scheduling a small change — target next sprint.

zoe: closing loop — I'll send the customer the chunking snippet + prefilter suggestion and keep timeline for the API change.

maria: nice. Also recommend adding a short note in the SDKs to auto-detect and chunk requests for rerank.
